entities.summary: Heinrich Johann Maria von Coudenhove-Kalergi, also known as Heinrich Coudenhove-Kalergi, was an Austro-Hungarian diplomat and writer who was a member of the Coudenhove-Kalergi family. He was born in Vienna and died in Ronsberg, Western Bohemia. He spoke 18 languages, and his diplomatic postings included Athens, Rio de Janeiro, Constantinople and Buenos Aires.
